description: The arrival of enemy Skins, duplicate pod-born aliens and memories of the 1947 crash expands the conflict beyond Roswell. Max is pushed toward leadership and an alien destiny while Liz's resistance to that future becomes inseparable from a mystery inside their own group.

s02e01.description: Michael's arrest over Agent Pierce's death threatens the group's secret just as Max tries to reconcile his alien destiny with his feelings for Liz.

s02e02.description: After Nasedo is killed, Max reluctantly assumes leadership and tries to restore normal life while suspicious newcomers suggest the alien conflict has followed them home.

s02e03.description: Isabel's birthday becomes a rescue mission when Tess is captured by the Skins and Michael finds a revealing file in Congresswoman Whitaker's office.

s02e04.description: A veteran's memories of the 1947 crash and military cover-up give Michael a vivid window into the first days of the Roswell mystery.

s02e05.description: A future version of Max arrives with a grim warning that his relationship with Liz must end if a catastrophic future is to be prevented.

s02e06.description: Whitaker's death leads the group to a gathering of Skins, where enemy aliens are preparing to replace their failing bodies.

s02e07.description: The Skins make Roswell's human population vanish so they can hunt the Royal Four without interference, turning the town into an eerie battlefield.

s02e08.description: A second pod squad arrives in Roswell looking like harder-edged doubles of Max, Isabel, Michael and Tess, raising new questions about the Royal Four.

s02e09.description: Max and Tess travel to New York with Lonnie and Rath for a summit of alien leaders where Max's identity as a king is tested against political reality.

s02e10.description: Haunted by a man he could not save, Max searches for a way to make amends while Isabel throws herself into an aggressively festive Christmas.

s02e11.description: Isabel's visions of a girl buried alive trigger a desperate search, while Valenti's unusual loyalty to the teens draws official attention.

s02e12.description: Valenti risks his badge to help the group find Laurie Dupree, a young woman whose disappearance and confinement may connect to the aliens.

s02e13.description: Laurie escapes her handlers and joins Michael and Maria in tracing her past, while federal investigator Duff presses Valenti about his increasingly suspicious conduct.

s02e14.description: Laurie's inheritance exposes the motive behind her abduction, and Michael must save her while uncovering a genetic connection with startling implications.

s02e15.description: Michael spends hush money by taking the group to Las Vegas, where freedom, gambling and romance briefly replace alien conspiracies with more ordinary chaos.

s02e16.description: Brody's mind is overwhelmed by memories from the alien Larek, leading to a hostage crisis inside the UFO center with Max and Tess trapped at its center.

s02e17.description: Prom night forces the friends to confront shifting romances and feelings they have avoided, with alien destiny proving no easier than teenage love.

s02e18.description: A sudden death devastates the group, but Liz refuses to accept the official explanation and begins investigating what really happened.

s02e19.description: Liz's investigation into Alex's death increasingly points toward alien involvement, placing her at odds with the friends whose secret she has always protected.

s02e20.description: Tess reveals she is carrying Max's child and that Earth may be harming the baby, while Liz, Maria and Michael discover a hidden piece of Alex's final months.

s02e21.description: As the Royal Four prepare to leave Earth, Max insists on solving Alex's murder first and uncovers a betrayal that changes the meaning of their supposed destiny.
